text:
These letters are fictional demonstration material, written for this project.
I left the porch lamp burning until your bicycle appeared at the bend. Some evenings I warmed the same soup three times.
The blue cup has a crack under its handle. I keep it because you painted the uneven stars on its side.

When the factory closed, I put my work boots by the door for another month. I did not know where else to put the mornings.
I planted beans beside the fence. By July the empty wire was carrying something green.

We could not bring the piano when we moved. I packed the sheet music between the plates so the corners would not bend.
On Sundays I still tap the melody on the kitchen table. The neighbors probably think I am fixing something.
